simple.meaning: חוֹר (chôwr) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a cavity , socket , den.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Samuel 14:11. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוֹר (H2356) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חוֹר (chôwr) / H2356 is traced through 1 Samuel 14:11, 2 Kings 12:10, Job 30:6, Song of Songs 5:4 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

timeline.evidenceText: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”
When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in Yahweh’s house.
So that they dwell in frightful valleys,
He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

“Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

definitions.full: H2356. chor III. חוֺר חֹר, noun [masculine] hole ; — absolute חֹר 2Kin 12:10 ; Ezek 8:7 (strike out Co B etc.), חוֺר Song 5:4 , חֹרִים 1Sam 14:11 ; construct חֹרֵי Job 30:6 ; suffix חֹרָיו Nahum 2:13 , חֹרֵיהֶן Zech 14:12 ; — hole in lid of chest 2Kin 12:10 (made by boring, נקב ), in door Song 5:4 ; in wall Ezek 8:7 (see above); = eye-socket בְּח תִּמַּקְנָה ׳עיניו Zech 14:12 (plague of enemies of Jerusalem); holes as hiding-places for men 1Sam 14:11 , so also 13:6 Ew We Dr (for חוחים ᵑ0 ), dwelling of outcast people עָפָר חרי Job 30:6 ; of dens of lions Nahum 2:13 . — I. חֹר , see II. חור .
